Agent logos in Contents/Resources/AgentLogos

Byte Ports shows each detected coding agent with its brand mark. The marks are trademarks of their owners and are
used with their permission. Byte Ports is not affiliated with or endorsed by these companies. The files are the
owners' published vector logos, unchanged apart from removed metadata and a square viewBox where noted.

claude.svg    Claude Spark. Anthropic, PBC. https://www.anthropic.com/press-kit
codex.svg     Codex. OpenAI. Vector from LobeHub Icons (MIT, notice below), arc flags re-serialized.
              https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons
gemini.svg    Gemini. Google LLC. https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/productlogos/gemini_2026/v1/192px.svg
copilot.svg   GitHub Copilot. GitHub, Inc. https://brand.github.com
cursor.svg    Cursor cube. Anysphere, Inc. https://cursor.com/brand (square viewBox)
opencode.svg  OpenCode. Anomaly Innovations, Inc. https://opencode.ai/brand (MIT repository, notice below)
aider.svg     Aider. Aider-AI. https://aider.chat/assets/icons/safari-pinned-tab.svg
goose.svg     goose. LF Projects, LLC. https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose (Apache-2.0 repository)
qwen.svg      Qwen Code. Alibaba Cloud. https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code (Apache-2.0 repository)
kimi.svg      Kimi. Moonshot AI. https://www.kimi.com/resources/kimi-brand
droid.svg     Factory Droid. The San Francisco AI Factory, Inc. https://github.com/Factory-AI/factory-zed-extension
              (Apache-2.0 repository, viewBox added)
vibe.svg      Mistral Vibe. Mistral AI. https://mistral.ai/brand
kiro.svg      Kiro. Amazon Web Services, Inc. or its affiliates. https://kiro.dev
hermes.svg    Hermes Agent. Nous Research. https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent (MIT, notice below,
              square viewBox)
pi.svg        pi. Mario Zechner, Earendil Inc. https://pi.dev/press-kit
amp.svg       Amp. https://ampcode.com/press-kit
cline.svg     Cline. Cline Bot Inc. https://cline.bot/brand
kilo.svg      Kilo Code. Kilo Code, Inc. https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode (MIT, notice below)
